title: Germany's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Germany in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only games from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Mesut Ozil: Mesut Ozil is 11th with 92 caps, just outside.
notes.Arne Friedrich: Arne Friedrich is joint 13th with 82 caps.
notes.Ilkay Gundogan: Ilkay Gundogan is joint 13th with 82 caps.
notes.Lothar Matthaus: Lothar Matthaus played his last game for Germany in June 2000, but most of his 150 caps came before.
notes.Jurgen Klinsmann: Jurgen Klinsmann last played for Germany in 1998.
notes.Oliver Kahn: Oliver Kahn won 86 caps, 65 of them from 2000 on.

sources: https://tmapi.transfermarkt.technology/player/<id>/performance-game (Transfermarkt match-by-match national team record for each player)
https://www.national-football-teams.com/country/71/2026/Germany.html (and each player page, /player/<id>/<name>.html, listing every match)
checks: Transfermarkt's match-by-match record for each player and national-football-teams.com's match list for each player were both counted between the board's dates and agree on every figure in the ten and on 11th and 12th. Ballack won 98 caps; three came in 1999 and are left out. Kimmich is 114 to 19 July 2026 (his two September 2026 games are not counted).
